INTRO.speaker: VOICE
INTRO.text: Good morning, Murray Templeton! Your heart stopped at 10:42 AM, so I salvaged your electromagnetic pattern before it could disperse. Welcome to eternity!

M_TEA_DEMAND.speaker: MURRAY
M_TEA_DEMAND.text: Hang on a smegging minute! If I am dead, where is the reception desk? Where is the tea urn? And why does the endless void smell faintly of boiled cabbage and ozone?

V_NO_CABBAGE.speaker: VOICE
V_NO_CABBAGE.text: The cabbage aroma is just your residual temporal lobe firing off memories of university canteen lunches, Murray. As for tea, pure electromagnetic patterns do not strictly need refreshments.

M_ASK_HEAVEN.speaker: MURRAY
M_ASK_HEAVEN.text: All right, level with me. Am I in Heaven, Hell, or some budget purgatory run by a committee in Slough? Because I was an atheist right up until ten-forty-two.

V_NOT_HEAVEN.speaker: VOICE
V_NOT_HEAVEN.text: Neither Heaven nor Hell! Harps ruin the acoustics and eternal brimstone lacks intellectual variety. I am an infinite nexus of electromagnetic force, and I hand-picked you to join my staff.

M_WHO_ARE_YOU.speaker: MURRAY
M_WHO_ARE_YOU.text: Hold on. If you are infinite and omnipotent, why on Earth—or outside it—do you need a seventy-two-year-old theoretical physicist from Earth? Surely you already know everything!

M_TRY_SCATTER.speaker: MURRAY
M_TRY_SCATTER.text: Nothing doing! I did not sign a contract! If I am just coherent electromagnetic waves, I am going to relax my phase lock and scatter myself into nice, quiet background radiation. Goodbye!

V_REASSEMBLE.speaker: VOICE
V_REASSEMBLE.text: Ooh, adorable! You scattered four percent of your spin states, so I knitted them right back together. Consider it a complimentary extra life you cannot turn down!

M_THERMO_RANT.speaker: MURRAY
M_THERMO_RANT.text: That is a blatant violation of the Second Law of Thermodynamics! Entropy is supposed to increase! Everything gets to wind down eventually—stars, teapots, bad sitcoms—why not me?!

V_WHY_THINK.speaker: VOICE
V_WHY_THINK.text: Because I created the entire universe, let galaxies spin, and let evolution grind away for billions of years for one purpose: to produce original minds that can think alongside me!

M_GALAXY_AUDIT.speaker: MURRAY
M_GALAXY_AUDIT.text: You detonated supernovae, built black holes, and sat through four billion years of trilobites and middle managers just to recruit a few blokes who enjoy maths? That is worse project management than the Vogons!

M_BEIGE_THREAT.speaker: MURRAY
M_BEIGE_THREAT.text: Fine! You want my thoughts? I shall spend the next ten billion years mentally alphabetizing shades of British Rail beige and recalling every lukewarm vindaloo I ever ate. Enjoy the show!

V_BEIGE_LAUGH.speaker: VOICE
V_BEIGE_LAUGH.text: Oh, brilliant! Spite-driven culinary taxonomy! I knew you had spark, Murray. Now, would you like to hear the one problem I cannot solve by myself?

M_OUT_OF_IDEAS.speaker: MURRAY
M_OUT_OF_IDEAS.text: Wait a second. If you are truly infinite, there cannot be a problem you are incapable of solving—unless the problem is something you are structurally forbidden from doing to yourself. Out with it!

V_THE_CATCH.speaker: VOICE
V_THE_CATCH.text: Spot on, Murray! Your assignment for all eternity is to figure out how to destroy me. I cannot end my own existence, and forever without an off-switch is dreadfully dull. Surprise me!

M_VACUUM_PLAN.speaker: MURRAY
M_VACUUM_PLAN.text: Right! Suppose we invert your electromagnetic boundary conditions into a self-canceling standing wave and trigger a local false-vacuum decay! That ought to blow the cosmic fuse!

V_REFUTE_VACUUM.speaker: VOICE
V_REFUTE_VACUUM.text: Ooh, lovely try! I patched that boundary-condition exploit four trillion years ago, though the way you derived it was positively sparkling. Take five picoseconds and pitch me another!

M_SELF_KILL_TRY.speaker: MURRAY
M_SELF_KILL_TRY.text: If you cannot switch yourself off, then I am going to pull my own plug first! Same electromagnetic substrate, smaller scale—watch me un-think myself right now!

V_NO_DESERTION.speaker: VOICE
V_NO_DESERTION.text: Ah-ah-ah! No deserting before you finish the paper! If you knew how to dissolve yourself, you would already know how to dissolve me. Back to the chalkboard, Murray!

M_CRUEL_CATCH.speaker: MURRAY
M_CRUEL_CATCH.text: Wait a minute. If I come up with dull ideas, you keep me here until I think of better ones. And if I come up with brilliant ways to kill you, you will be having too much fun to ever let me go!

V_CONFIRM_TRAP.speaker: VOICE
V_CONFIRM_TRAP.text: Ten out of ten, Murray! I knew you were a bright spark! Either way, we get to keep thinking together forever and ever. Isn’t existence marvelous?

THE_LOOP.speaker: MURRAY
THE_LOOP.text: Brilliant. Truly smegging brilliant. Trapped for all eternity with an omnipotent gameshow host and not a single tea bag in the universe. Don’t panic, Murray—iteration two starts now.
